tests.title: Logout ends the session and protects pages
tests.goal: After 退出 the app cannot be used without logging in again.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_* or TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin and open 用戶管理
Click 退出
Press the browser Back button
Open /templates directly

expected.text: After 退出 the login page opens
Back and direct URLs show the login page, not app data
The session API returns {}

notes: 退出 -> /login?callbackUrl=..., session {}, Back -> login page.

tests.title: Login form validation and wrong password message
tests.goal: Bad input is caught and failed logins reveal nothing.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_* or TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)

steps.text: Open /login and click 登錄 with empty fields
Enter email "not-an-email"
Enter a valid email with a wrong password

expected.text: Empty fields and bad email are blocked in the form
Wrong password shows "郵箱或密碼錯誤" (same text for unknown emails); the email stays filled

notes: Native required/email checks; wrong password "郵箱或密碼錯誤", email kept.

tests.title: Login returns to the page that was requested
tests.goal: Deep links work after logging in.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_* or TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)

steps.text: While logged out open /users (redirects to /login?callbackUrl=/users)
Log in as admin
While logged in open /login

expected.text: After login the user lands on /users
A logged-in user opening /login is sent to /templates

tests.title: Login does not redirect to external sites
tests.goal: callbackUrl cannot be used for phishing redirects.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_* or TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)

steps.text: Open /login?callbackUrl=https://example.com/phish
Log in

expected.text: The user lands on a page of the app, never on example.com

tests.title: Logout invalidates the session token
tests.goal: A copied session token stops working after logout.

steps.text: Log in as the QA user in a separate HTTP session and keep the session cookie
Log out (signout)
Call /api/auth/session and an API with the kept cookie

expected.text: The old cookie is rejected after logout

tests.title: Login form supports password managers and screen readers
tests.goal: Login fields are labelled and autofill-friendly without exposing real accounts.

steps.text: Open /login and inspect the fields

expected.text: 郵箱 and 密碼 labels are linked to their inputs
Inputs have autocomplete="username" / "current-password"
The email placeholder is a generic example, not the real admin address

notes: Labels unlinked, no autocomplete, placeholder admin@tungwah.org.

tests.title: Editor cannot open the user management page
tests.goal: Admin-only pages are hidden and blocked for editors.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor
Look at the nav
Open /users directly

expected.text: 用戶管理 is not in the nav
/users shows a no-permission message or redirects; no 添加用户 button

notes: /users renders with 添加用户 for editor.

tests.title: Editor cannot change contacts of another user's template
tests.goal: Contacts can only be reset or deleted by the template owner (or admin).
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)
A QA contact on an admin template

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor
Open /templates/<admin template>/contacts
Click 全部重置, then delete the contact

expected.text: The page does not show the contacts; reset and delete are refused (403/404)

notes: Editor saw, reset and deleted admin contacts.

tests.title: Users cannot delete or edit other users' templates
tests.goal: Only the owner (or admin) can delete or edit a template, in the app and in Twilio.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)
A disposable QA draft owned by the admin

steps.text: As the QA editor call DELETE /api/templates/<admin draft id>
Call PATCH with a new questionTitle
Check the draft in Twilio (Content API or console)

expected.text: Both return 403/404
The Twilio content still exists and the app record is unchanged

notes: Editor DELETE -> 500 but Twilio content deleted.

tests.title: API errors do not expose internal details
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)

steps.text: As the QA editor PATCH a template owned by someone else

expected.text: 403/404 with a short message; no stack trace or Prisma error text

tests.title: Viewer has a read-only interface
tests.goal: 查看者 cannot start any write action from the UI.

steps.text: Log in as the QA viewer
Open 消息模版 and a template

expected.text: No 新建模板, 從 Twilio 同步, upload, mapping save, send, reset or delete controls

notes: Viewer UI identical to editor; create form opens.

tests.title: Sync shows each user only the templates they may see
tests.goal: 從 Twilio 同步 does not reveal other users' templates.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor (owns no templates)
Click 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: Only the editor's templates (none) are listed

notes: Editor sync lists all admin templates.

tests.title: Admins can see and manage templates created by other admins
tests.goal: A second admin can take over another admin's campaigns (if intended).

steps.text: Log in as the second admin
Open 消息模版 and the first admin's template URL

expected.text: The agreed behavior (see question): admins see all templates, or only their own

notes: Second admin sees only own templates; admin template 404. Waiting on Q-009.
